paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : StableMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and bits per character (BPC) for two validating models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” with units of (x10³), has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 50, and has tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.15 to 2.25, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. A cyan line, labeled “StableMoE Validating,” is composed of markers connected by solid lines; it begins at approximately (0, 2.23) and declines to approximately (50, 1.17). A magenta line, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” is similarly composed of markers connected by solid lines; it starts at approximately (0, 2.25) and declines to approximately (50, 1.16).
